en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet town street lined with small houses and trees, leading toward a large historic church with a steep gabled roof and a tall Baroque-style tower topped by an onion dome and spire. In the foreground a woman in long dark dress and bonnet walks with a boy in a cap; a few other figures appear further up the street. The scene is framed by tree branches at the top, giving a picturesque village impression.
